name: picsart
description: Connect Picsart to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Picsart MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Picsart to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with aI image, video and audio tools using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Picsart workspace.
Find anything in Picsart that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review aI image, video and audio tools in Picsart.
